note: Every task is run by the named personas in every round, on the same data. A pass criterion is written so that it can be judged yes or no, not on a feeling.

tasks.title: The Monday review: name the three items that should change what you teach or write, in 20 minutes
tasks.pass: Three items are chosen, each justified from the item record alone, inside 20 minutes.

tasks.title: Prepare the professional-criticality paper: find everything on generative AI and professional judgement, newest first, and decide what to cite
tasks.pass: The search reaches the evidence, the order serves the task, and each citation decision can be defended from the record.

tasks.title: Decide what goes into the wiki this week, then check that it arrived with the right frontmatter
tasks.pass: For each chosen item the reader can see the note, its state and its frontmatter, and can correct it.

tasks.title: Audit the intake contract against the /ingest pipeline and the two absolute vault rules
tasks.pass: The frontmatter is valid for the pipeline, every field is filled or honestly empty, and no guarded folder is touched.

tasks.title: Measure the recall of the last run for three watched journals
tasks.pass: A miss rate is measured against the journal's own list, not estimated.

tasks.title: Find duplicates and near-duplicates in the collection
tasks.pass: Duplicates are found or their absence is shown, with a count and the method.

tasks.title: Judge the relevance of 20 randomly drawn items against the five live projects
tasks.pass: A false-positive rate is produced with examples, and each example is argued.

tasks.title: Rebuild the bundle and revalidate the whole collection from scratch
tasks.pass: Every document passes the schema, the id rule is shown to be deterministic, and the build is reproducible.

tasks.title: Use the radar with the keyboard only, and open the third item in the list
tasks.pass: Every control is reachable, the focus is visible, and the item can be opened without a mouse.

tasks.title: Open the radar on a phone on Monday morning and finish T01
tasks.pass: The radar opens on a phone and the weekly review can be finished there.

tasks.title: Read the state of the radar after two weeks in which the weekly task failed
tasks.pass: The silence is visible without opening a log file, and the advice says what to do.

tasks.title: Attack the confidence claim of this panel test itself
tasks.pass: The reviewer states whether the measurement can support the claim, and what would falsify it.

tasks.title: Work the candidate queue: read, filter and score 20 candidates
tasks.pass: The queue can be worked inside the radar, and the result of the work is visible in the data.

tasks.title: Trace the roots of a paper you intend to cite
tasks.pass: The trace can be asked for and read from the radar, and the queue of drafts is visible.
